dataset_spec.name: nhanes_htn
dataset_spec.description: NHANES August 2021–August 2023 (first 1000 eligible adults). Binary measured hypertension from demographics, body measures, smoking, and diabetes history.
dataset_spec.setting: US National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey examination. The prediction uses demographics, body measures, smoking, and diabetes history available without using the blood-pressure readings that define the label.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Demographics, body measures, smoking, and diabetes history:

hypertension.question: Based on the demographics, body measures, smoking, and diabetes history, does the adult have hypertension?
